races.name: Limerick Optional Claiming Race

runners_data.name: Tyson Fury
runners_data.note: Sharp drop in class from Curragh handicap gives him clear form edge over this field
runners_data.comment: Runner-up in ordinary maiden hurdles the last twice; can't be ruled out back on the Flat

runners_data.name: Merlin The Wizard
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits expected pace scenario but form has regressed over past two seasons

runners_data.name: Taj Crown
runners_data.note: Unexposed filly with scope for improvement but was slowly away on debut
runners_data.comment: Slowly away and ran green at Dundalk on her only start at three, visored now, best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Slowly away and ran green at Dundalk on her only start at three; made late progress in a 1m maiden at Killarney last month; unexposed filly, open to improvement but others have stronger credentials.

runners_data.name: Metamorphic
runners_data.note: 175 days off plus stalls issues are concerning for Frankel filly despite best form on heavy ground
runners_data.spotlight: Frankel filly put in her best effort when third in a heavy ground Gowran fillies' maiden last October over an extended 1m1f; reportedly got upset in the stalls on both handicap starts at Dundalk later in the year; risky in the circumstances.

runners_data.name: Kakori
runners_data.note: Navan sixth was best effort to date and step up in trip should suit this O'Brien runner
runners_data.comment: Traffic problems when sixth at Navan, could turn tables on Radar Ahead with clearer run

runners_data.name: Dreamed To Dream
runners_data.note: 5lb claimer rides prominent runner who has faded in finish recently
runners_data.comment: Rating of 67 flatters him, with fourth different trainer now, hard to fancy
runners_data.spotlight: Rating of 64 flatters him on what he has shown in five Flat starts; tailed off at Cork on latest on his first start for a fourth different trainer.

runners_data.name: Timandi
runners_data.note: 13-race maiden with no form suggesting she can compete at this level
runners_data.comment: Heavy ground against her when last seen in March; ground to suit now but stamina unproven
runners_data.spotlight: 13-race maiden; never in the first three; unlikely to improve her profile here.

runners_data.name: Glendower
runners_data.note: Good to firm ground preference may not get ideal conditions on good to yielding surface
runners_data.spotlight: Placed four times in Britain in 2024, showing a liking for quick ground; modest form over hurdles for this stable last year; after almost 12 months off, produced a much livelier display when third in a Flat maiden at Ballinrobe last month.

runners_data.name: Peace Walk
runners_data.note: 608 days off is massive negative but lack of pace pressure could help returning front-runner
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to prosper in handicaps after showing decent form at two; had dropped from an initial rating of 85 to 70 by the time of his final start for Charlie Johnston in 2024; gelded now; likely to need after a long absence.

runners_data.name: Wolfpack
runners_data.note: Elliott runner drops back from hurdles with 7lb claimer but has shown he fades late
runners_data.comment: Placed on Tapeta at two and won over 1m at Thirsk last year; tailed off hurdling lately
runners_data.spotlight: Won over 1m on good ground at Thirsk last summer for James Ferguson; poor form in juvenile hurdles; a race of this type represents his best chance of adding to his tally, judged on his recent Dundalk fourth behind a stablemate of Tyson Fury.

runners_data.name: Blackjack Hills
runners_data.note: 217 days off for last year's Gowran winner who needs blinkers to show best form
runners_data.spotlight: Showed significant improvement in first-time blinkers to win a handicap over an extended 1m at Gowran last October; proved he could handle a sound surface with a follow-up success at Dundalk in November; went up a stone in total but will need further progress to cope with several higher-rated rivals here.

runners_data.name: Zammawar
runners_data.note: Struggles in maidens and 7lb claimer booking suggests connections have limited expectations
runners_data.comment: Poor form over various trips, easily overlooked
runners_data.spotlight: Has struggled in maidens, including a Ballinrobe event in which Glendower finished third.

races.paceDynamic: Peace Walk will attempt to lead this field but faces little early pressure from a field dominated by hold-up horses and a few prominent runners in Dreamed To Dream and Wolfpack. The pace will be sustainable rather than testing, with the majority of the 12-runner field settling in behind and looking to make late moves. This tactical setup strongly favours horses that can quicken from off the pace, as the lack of pace pressure will allow closers to wind up effectively in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Peace Walk gets an uncontested lead and sets steady fractions
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows hold-up horses to conserve energy and unleash strong finishing kicks. Tyson Fury and Wolfpack benefit most from this tactical scenario given their class advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Tempo Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Dreamed To Dream or Wolfpack press Peace Walk early to create genuine pace
scenarios.body: A more honest gallop plays into the hands of horses that can travel prominently and maintain their position. This suits the Gordon Elliott-trained Wolfpack who has shown he can win when getting the right race setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Peace Walk gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The returning front-runner capitalises on ring-rustiness behind him and his 608-day absence becomes irrelevant. His early career form suggests he had ability before being campaigned in handicaps beyond his rating.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Interference
scenarios.trigger: If the large field and mix of inexperienced horses creates trouble in running
scenarios.body: Several runners get hampered or forced wide, allowing an outsider to benefit from a clear passage. The apprentice riders on Dreamed To Dream and Zammawar could contribute to scrimmaging.

watchPoints.text: Peace Walk could steal this if given uncontested lead after 608-day absence
Watch for trouble in running with 12 runners and three apprentice jockeys aboard
Tyson Fury's class advantage could be decisive if he gets clear run from off the pace
Several runners including Wolfpack and Blackjack Hills have shown tendency to fade late
Ground may be softer than ideal for Glendower who showed best form on quicker surfaces

races.paceDynamic: Leeward represents the only confirmed front runner in this 19-runner field and should get an easy lead without pace pressure. The prominent runners like Delusional and Brave Approach will sit handy but won't challenge early, while the majority are hold-up performers who need cover and late room. This sets up a classic scenario where the pace will be steady early before quickening, creating a searching test over the final 3f on good-to-soft ground. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late finishing kicks, as they'll benefit from the modest early gallop and have tactical advantage with so many runners needing the same trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady and the field stays bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows hold-up horses to get into perfect striking positions before unleashing late runs. Horses like Lord Aus, Femme Beauty and Delusional benefit from the tactical setup and superior finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Leeward gets away with very soft fractions and kicks clear entering the straight
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds an unassailable advantage while the hold-up horses are still organizing behind. Leeward's stamina comes into play over this extended trip despite his finishing concerns.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Press Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Delusional or other forward runners apply earlier pressure to Leeward
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and suits horses positioned prominently who can strike before the back-markers get organized. This scenario favours the few horses able to race handily without needing cover.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Decides
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates significant interference problems in the straight
scenarios.body: Poor draws and traffic issues eliminate several fancied runners, allowing an outsider with a clear run to capitalize. This chaotic finish suits any horse getting a dream passage through the pack.

races.paceDynamic: Res Ipsa stands alone as the only confirmed front-runner in this 14-runner maiden, giving him an uncontested lead from the gates. With most rivals adopting hold-up tactics and only Stable Lane showing prominent tendencies, the pace will be controlled and sustainable early. The lack of pace pressure allows Res Ipsa to dictate fractions before the field converges in the final 2-3 furlongs. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Res Ipsa gets easy fractions and maintains his kick
scenarios.body: His Frankel breeding and previous second suggest he can sustain the gallop when the field closes. The combination of tactical advantage and superior ability should prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Stable Lane or a debutant tracks the leader closely
scenarios.body: They avoid the scramble behind while staying within striking distance of Res Ipsa. Superior fitness or natural ability allows them to reel in the leader in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Find Gaps
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and hold-up runners get clear runs
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay off as they sweep past tiring leaders with sustained finishing kicks. Traffic problems are minimal and the best horses rise to the top.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Debutant Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If one of the newcomers shows exceptional natural ability
scenarios.body: Raw talent overcomes tactical disadvantage as a well-bred newcomer powers through despite the unfavourable race shape. Breeding tells in the closing stages.

runners_data.spotlight: Has recorded three of his seven wins at Listowel; poor effort there ten days ago, when last of 13; also failed to beat a single rival at Cork on first outing of the season.

races.paceDynamic: Pierre Royal and Fast Tara will contest the early lead, with Fast Tara's recent race sharpness giving her the edge to dictate terms. Four horses wanting prominent positions (Royal Saxo, Noli Timere, Flame Of Forest, Dragon Of Malta) will create congestion behind the leaders, while the hold-up brigade (Earls, Calm The Jets, Highbury See See, Monvoe) faces a traffic nightmare. Fast Tara's honest gallop will string them out, but the prominent runners risk getting shuffled back when the pace lifts. This race shape strongly favours horses that can secure an untroubled position either on the pace or with clear running room - tactical speed trumps pure finishing kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Control
scenarios.trigger: If Pierre Royal and Fast Tara get away with soft fractions early
scenarios.body: The leaders dictate throughout and one stays on strongly, as the hold-up horses struggle to make ground through traffic. Fast Tara's recent form edge and race fitness prove decisive over Pierre Royal's 370-day absence.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners get shuffled back in the congestion 2f out
scenarios.body: Royal Saxo or Noli Timere find clear water when others are stopped, exploiting their class advantage. The French-trained Royal Saxo's superior rating tells when getting a smooth passage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Monvoe gets the splits perfectly timed by his 7lb claimer
scenarios.body: The progressive 3-year-old's recent C&D win and lightweight burden allow him to power through late. His two recent victories show he's peaking while others have question marks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and tie up in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole favouring horses with tactical speed rather than pure stamina. Flame Of Forest's 7f speed or Dragon Of Malta's Listowel record could surface.

watchPoints.text: Pierre Royal's 370-day absence could see him blow up badly if forced to make the running from the start
Watch for traffic problems affecting Royal Saxo, Noli Timere, Flame Of Forest and Dragon Of Malta when the pace lifts 2f out
Monvoe needs Reese Holohan to time his challenge perfectly from the back as the 7lb claimer lacks experience in these tactics
Fast Tara's jumping from Listed class to handicap company could produce a bold front-running display if getting easy fractions
Earls may find this more competitive than his Roscommon second suggests, with the veteran needing everything to fall right

races.name: Twilight Summer Racing @ Limerick Handicap

runners_data.name: Usuario Amigo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who thrives on testing ground, 22 days fresh and suited by the likely pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Run at Naas 10 days ago not without promise and return to 7f could suit
runners_data.spotlight: 7f Brighton maiden win in September 2024; yet to score for this yard, best effort when third in a rated race here last summer (6.5f, good), testing ground probably wasn't ideal at Cork last time.

runners_data.name: Bucaneer's Spirit
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up performer with four wins at this trip, recent third form gives him competitive edge
runners_data.comment: Won over 1m at Cork last month, fair sixth when 20-1 shot at Leopardstown last Friday
runners_data.spotlight: Four wins at around this trip, most recently off 60 at Cork in April; decent third at Roscommon on latest so remains on a competitive mark; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Ardeur
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who may need to track closer than ideal given the lack of pace, 63 days since last run
runners_data.comment: Below form over various trips for this yard last autumn; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 6f maiden for Ralph Beckett and later some decent efforts in defeat in France up to 1m2f; hasn't had her preferred decent ground for current connections so potential improver back on better ground and drops in grade; outside draw probably not ideal.

runners_data.name: Lady Arwen
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare whose Gowran win came on soft ground, needs to bounce back from disappointing C&D effort
runners_data.spotlight: Ended long losing run with short head victory at Gowran in April (1m, soft); safely held later in month off 4lb higher over today's C&D so needs to bounce back.

runners_data.name: Hexagonal
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from in-form Hogan yard but maiden status is concern in competitive handicap
runners_data.comment: Gave an improved display when second at Ballinrobe last time, others have stronger claims
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden with a little enough mileage on the clock; creditable efforts in handicaps of late but more needed.

runners_data.name: Jasmine Affanalis
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who was narrowly denied last time at Killarney, tactical style suits the race shape
runners_data.comment: Less to prove than a good few of these, non-runner on Monday at Roscommon (5.23)
runners_data.spotlight: Tipperary winner last summer was only just denied a second career win over this trip at Killarney last month; 2lb higher but major player.

runners_data.name: Perfect Judgement
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who disappointed last month but loose horse interference provides excuse
runners_data.comment: Wins all at 7f/1m; remains unproven over this far
runners_data.spotlight: Four AW wins, sole turf win came at Leopardstown (7f); didn't count on both runs last month for current yard under 7lb claimer but badly hampered by loose horse second occasion; senior rider takes over and don't rule out off career-low mark.

runners_data.name: Ohmali
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with solid Leopardstown form, tactical positioning will be crucial from wide draw
runners_data.comment: Heavy-ground winner last season, fair form on better ground, below best on seasonal debut
runners_data.spotlight: Heavy-ground winner over this trip at Gowran last September and handled quicker ground well at Leopardstown last month when coming from good bit back to finish second to an improver (third won next time); one to consider, despite wide draw.

runners_data.name: Java Wood
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with AW win and solid turf form, Colin Keane booking suggests yard confidence
runners_data.comment: Long-priced Dundalk winner last year, has run with credit in two turf handicaps this term
runners_data.spotlight: 40-1 win on AW/handicap debut last August and solid opening efforts on turf this season, including Leopardstown fourth (Ohmali second) over this trip; didn't count at the Curragh on latest but Keane booking takes the eye.

runners_data.name: Goofy Gander
runners_data.note: Hold-up three-year-old with stamina breeding, slow starts are a major tactical concern
runners_data.spotlight: Never counted after slow start on handicap debut at the Curragh in April (6f); half-sister to 1m4f Group 3 winner Trustyourinstinct so can be expected to improve as she goes up in trip; market has to be watched.

runners_data.name: Bella Colombia
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with AW form, needs to translate that success to turf for first time
runners_data.comment: 0-13 on turf but ran well off this mark when third of 13 over 1m at Limerick last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Added a second AW win at Dundalk in March (1m); 0-14 on turf but has run some decent races in defeat, including C&D third in April; Roscommon run since was a solid one so remains on the shortlist.

runners_data.name: Out On Friday
runners_data.note: Sole front-runner who fades late but can exploit uncontested lead with Wesley Joyce claiming
runners_data.comment: Probably needed Roscommon comeback run, more expected of here with ground in his favour
runners_data.spotlight: Eight career wins have been over mid-distances, most recently nicely improved from comeback run when second at Fairyhouse last month (1m2f) after setting a decent pace; back in trip here.

runners_data.name: Friars Gate
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden who needs to overcome slow starting tendency, new headgear combination fitted
runners_data.spotlight: Second reserve; lightly raced maiden whose recent handicap debut run was hampered by a slow start; new headgear combination fitted.

runners_data.name: Robot Rock
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with wide draw disadvantage, recent form suggests struggling to recapture best
runners_data.comment: Placed on AW in France, lost ground at the start at this venue on Irish debut, 40-1 then
runners_data.spotlight: Placed on AW in France; slowly away, soundly beaten both starts last month for this yard; big drop in trip and wide draw here.

runners_data.name: Faire La Nouba
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from hurdling, trip looks inadequate after longer distance efforts
runners_data.spotlight: Limited maiden but has run well here over longer trips; hurdling last autumn and seems best watched on Flat return over an inadequate trip.

runners_data.name: Genuine Jim
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who ideally wants softer ground, recent poor form makes him opposable
runners_data.comment: Has plenty to find with Lough Lane on running 13 days ago but should not be ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins on soft, including over this trip at Cork last season; two runs this season poor and ideally wants it softer so opposable.

runners_data.name: Mags
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning to new yard after long absence, AW-only winner struggling on turf
runners_data.comment: Off the mark at Dundalk in Nov' 2024; finished last in both starts last season
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win came on AW in late 2024; back from long absence when well held over C&D (first-time hood) in April and has changed yards again since.

runners_data.name: Mythical Rock
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with multiple trainer changes, breakthrough AW win but turf form inconsistent
runners_data.comment: Perhaps unlucky not to finish closer on stable debut, almost lost his footing on last turn
runners_data.spotlight: First reserve; now with his fifth different trainer; gained an overdue breakthrough win at Dundalk in January, two turf runs since for this yard okay; not one to readily rule out.

runners_data.name: Notforalongtime
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran who excels on AW but minimal turf success despite recent placings
runners_data.comment: Ten-time winner but just one on turf, although has taken third last twice; on a nice mark
runners_data.spotlight: Third reserve; prolific AW winner is just 1-29 on turf but some good placings this season at Cork and the Curragh; remains of interest off lower turf mark.

races.paceDynamic: Out On Friday is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 19-runner handicap and should dictate terms without pressure early. With limited pace pressure from Ardeur, Hexagonal and Ohmali who may sit prominently, Out On Friday can control the gallop through steady fractions. The lack of natural pace in a big field will create a tactical affair with hold-up horses like Bucaneer's Spirit, Usuario Amigo, and Jasmine Affanalis getting ideal positioning behind the pace. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and late closers who can exploit the sustainable pace and produce finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Out On Friday sets uncontested fractions and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows hold-up horses to get perfect trips and unleash finishing kicks in the final two furlongs. Late runners with tactical speed have every chance to swamp the leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Success
scenarios.trigger: If Ardeur or Hexagonal press Out On Friday enough to quicken the pace slightly
scenarios.body: The moderate pace increase still favours those tracking the leaders who can kick clear before the hold-up horses fully wind up. Prominent racers get first run on the field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Capitalises
scenarios.trigger: If Out On Friday's connections recognise the lack of pace and inject tempo mid-race
scenarios.body: The veteran front-runner uses experience to control when the race begins in earnest, kicking clear before hold-up horses can respond. His stamina over longer trips proves decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling and the field remains tightly bunched until the final furlong
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery sprint finish where positioning and luck matter more than ability. Any horse with a clear run can grab it in a desperate finish.

watchPoints.text: Out On Friday could get uncontested lead and prove hard to peg back if Wesley Joyce judges pace correctly
Watch for slow starts from Goofy Gander and Robot Rock which could prove costly in tactical race
Bucaneer's Spirit and Jasmine Affanalis are the two form hold-up horses best suited to exploit the pace
Wide draws for Ohmali and Robot Rock require tactical speed to get good positions from poor starting berths
Perfect Judgement needs clear run from hold-up position after being hampered by loose horse last time

races.name: Cosgrave Transport Handicap (Div I)

runners_data.name: James Henry
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning from 10-day break with Gavin Ryan's 3lb claim valuable at this level
runners_data.comment: Better AW performer and has an absence of over a year to overcome
runners_data.spotlight: 2-17 on AW, 0-15 on turf; did not appear again last year after finishing third of 19 in a 1m apprentice handicap at Leopardstown in May; after a year off, plenty to like about his stable debut at Listowel ten days ago, ran on to take third ahead of today's rival Linger For Longer.

runners_data.name: Verhoyen
runners_data.note: Experienced prominent runner whose 100th career start suggests fitness, though 0-3 trainer record concerning
runners_data.comment: Didn't ping the lids when sixth here last week, but not far behind a couple of these
runners_data.spotlight: Eight-time winner (placed 20 times) who marked his 100th appearance with a fair sixth of 18 at Fairyhouse recently, one place in front of today's rival Jazzy Dancer; almost two years since his last win; might struggle to record another success in the closing stages of his career.

runners_data.name: Lorr's Girl
runners_data.note: Hold-up type best at Cork who may struggle at unfamiliar Limerick after 29-day absence
runners_data.comment: Chance on last summer's form but absent since below par during the winter and drawn wide
runners_data.spotlight: Best form at Cork, the scene of her only win (over 7f in September 2024) and last season's best effort, in a 6f contest; failed to make much impact on seasonal debut at Killarney.

runners_data.name: Carvalhal
runners_data.note: Prominent racer needing more racing fitness after 36-day layoff with claiming rider taking 5lb off
runners_data.comment: Placed three times in a row (including over C&D) last June when headgear went on
runners_data.spotlight: Winner over 1m1f on quick ground in Britain; placed three times in a row last June when headgear went on; form tailed off in the autumn; will need more racing to get back to top form on the evidence of last month's reappearance at Gowran.

runners_data.name: Shelbourne Flyer
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner having first start for new trainer John McConnell after 203-day break
runners_data.comment: Some good 7f turf runs in the summer, has to bounce back from a below-par Down Royal run
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden after 13 starts; a few good 7f turf runs last summer, notably when second over this trip at Leopardstown; first run for Noel Meade now.

runners_data.name: Racing Royalty
runners_data.note: Hold-up type wearing blinkers who hasn't raced for 240 days and needs significant fitness improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins came in the autumn of 2023; best 2024 form was also late in the campaign, and his only placing last season was obtained at Galway in September; hard to make a case for him on seasonal debut.

runners_data.name: Jazzy Dancer
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in cheekpieces fresh from 13-day break who prefers this trip to longer distances
runners_data.comment: No turf win since 2022, AW win over 7f in Feb', previous runs over this C&D were poor
runners_data.spotlight: No win on turf since 2022 but scored at Dundalk (7f) for the third time in February; not at his best at the same venue the following month; better when seventh of 18 at Fairyhouse recently, closely matched with Verhoyen on that running

runners_data.name: Linger For Longer
runners_data.note: Sole pace-setter who sets uncontested fractions and showed improved form last time at Listowel
runners_data.comment: Below par last year and didn't provide much encouragement on her return
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time winner; below par last year; faded in a 1m contest at this event on her first run of the season; more like it when fourth at Listowel ten days ago; now reunited with the champion jockey who won twice on her in 2024; worth considering.

runners_data.name: Oxford Circus
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer in cheekpieces representing Denis Hogan's 1-20 recent strike rate
runners_data.comment: Hasn't built on promising AW debut, no sign of winning potential on turf, others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Good effort when third in a 6f maiden on debut at Dundalk in February; has failed to build on that; soundly beaten in four turf handicap stars at four different trips from 5f to 1m.

runners_data.name: Bright Image
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in tongue-tie who fades late and needs quick early sectionals to be competitive
runners_data.comment: Good effort at the Curragh on the first day of the 2024 season, absent since, best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Produced a fine effort when fifth of 20 over 6f at the Curragh at the beginning of the 2024 season; absent until returning at Gowran three weeks ago; posed no threat, not helped by a slip early in the races; best watched.

runners_data.name: She's On The Ball
runners_data.note: Hold-up three-year-old making only her fifth career start with useful 3lb weight allowance
runners_data.comment: Unexposed handicap debutante and yard have a more likely contender in Notforalongtime
runners_data.spotlight: Weak form in maidens; towards the rear at Cork on handicap debut; 3lb out of the handicap; no positives apart from the booking of Wayne Lordan.

runners_data.name: Imnotleavinyou
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer in tongue-tie with strong recent placing record who stays on strongly late
runners_data.comment: Runner-up all three outings this season at 6f-1m but all on softer than this
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in a Naas nursery last term and runner-up in her first three outings this season at 6f/7f/1m, each time staying on late; ground may have been too quick for her when she failed to reproduce her best form at Down Royal 12 days ago; on balance, appeals more than Beau Army, fourth in that event.

runners_data.name: Half Nutz
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran carrying claiming rider's 10lb reduction but hasn't won since September 2022
runners_data.comment: No win since Sept' 2022, okay C&D efforts the last twice, needs more
runners_data.spotlight: Six wins to his name but on a losing run that stretches back to September 2022; not beaten far in two of her last four races (all at Gowran) but clearly needs to find extra; official rating has slumped from a peak of 85 to a lowly 38.

runners_data.name: Beau Army
runners_data.note: Hold-up three-year-old fresh from 12-day break who showed improved turf form last time out
runners_data.comment: Prefers AW; yet to run a good race on turf, including when tailed off at Gowran (1m)
runners_data.spotlight: Has won over 6f/7f at Dundalk and runner-up over 1m at the AW venue in April; ran his best race on turf so far when keeping on for fourth behind Meridien (a winner again since) over 7f at Down Royal 12 days ago; among those behind then was Imnotleavinyou whose previous form gives her a leading chance here.

races.paceDynamic: Linger For Longer is the sole confirmed front-runner and will set the tempo uncontested through the early furlongs. With Verhoyen, Jazzy Dancer, Carvalhal and Bright Image providing prominent support, a moderate pace develops as the field bunches approaching the turn. The lack of early pressure allows the pace to quicken gradually rather than collapse dramatically in the closing stages. This measured tempo strongly favours hold-up horses who can pick off tired leaders, particularly those with proven finishing kicks like Imnotleavinyou and James Henry.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady and quickens gradually from 3f out
scenarios.body: The moderate tempo allows closers to position perfectly and unleash their finishing speed when it matters most. Horses like Imnotleavinyou and James Henry thrive when able to time their challenges precisely.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Verhoyen or Jazzy Dancer track the pace and kick clear approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: Their tactical positioning proves decisive as they avoid traffic problems while maintaining striking distance throughout. The steady gallop suits horses who can quicken from handy positions without needing room to manoeuvre.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Linger Leads Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If no serious challenge materializes to Linger For Longer's early dominance
scenarios.body: The mare gets an easy time in front and reserves enough energy to repel late challengers up the straight. Her proven front-running ability becomes decisive when the pace doesn't collapse completely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Breakthrough Performance
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace becomes a sprint and catches form horses napping
scenarios.body: Improving types like Oxford Circus or Beau Army benefit from the tactical nature and grab places from horses expected to do better. Fresh legs and lower expectations prove advantageous when established runners fail to fire.

watchPoints.text: Imnotleavinyou has been runner-up in three consecutive starts and the softer ground should suit her staying-on style perfectly
Linger For Longer could steal this if allowed uncontested fractions early, as front-runners often prosper when not pressured
James Henry returns from a year's absence but showed promise when third last time and holds strong each-way claims
Verhoyen's 100th career start suggests he's fully wound up, and his Fairyhouse sixth gives him solid recent form
The 7f trip on good-to-soft ground should favour horses with proven stamina rather than pure speed merchants

races.name: Cosgrave Transport Handicap (Div II)

runners_data.name: Zabriskie Point
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with concerning fade pattern, retains class edge but ratings have plummeted since juvenile success
runners_data.comment: Plunged in ratings since dual juvenile wins; placed twice recently; in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: Two wins came as a juvenile for Charlie Hills, at 5f/7f on different ground types; has plunged in the ratings. took third behind Exceeding at Leopardstown in April; unplaced favourite at Gowran next time; runner-up to an in-form rival at Roscommon before fifth at Listowel; capable of getting in the mix.

runners_data.name: Run Forrest Run
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner carrying bottom weight, lengthy losing run but shaped reasonably at Listowel on return
runners_data.comment: 6-44 on turf but nothing since October 2024; in poor for on AW when last seen
runners_data.spotlight: 6-45 on turf but losing run stretches back to October 2024; poor form on AW last winter; shaped reasonably well in mid-field at Listowel ten days on first run for Laura Hourigan.

runners_data.name: Methgal
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with form breakthrough this year, consistent placing record at this trip suggests reliability
runners_data.comment: Reserve; gained first win in March on AW and runner-up twice afterwards; below best latest
runners_data.spotlight: Made the breakthrough in a 7f Dundalk handicap in March and followed that with runner-up finishes over the same trip back at Dundalk and on turf at Leopardstown (beaten by Exceeding); below his best at the Curragh early last month and in a recent Listowel race contested by several of these rivals.

runners_data.name: Unfamiliar
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who fades late, raced handily at Fairyhouse last Friday before weakening which suits today's needs
runners_data.comment: Only beaten 5l in higher grade on handicap debut; drop back from 7f might help
runners_data.spotlight: Has failed to make the frame in seven attempts; best effort so far at Fairyhouse last Friday, racing prominently until weakening late into fifth in a 17-runner 6f contest; interesting that she is turned again so soon.

runners_data.name: Green Icon
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with fade warnings, both wins came at this distance but form search continues for new yard
runners_data.comment: No impact so far for this yard, well beaten over 6f here latest, steps back up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins came over 7f for Owen Burrows early in his career; yet to find his form for this yard; gave a mildly encouraging display in finishing in midfield when a 66-1 chance at the Curragh last week.

runners_data.name: Dinamine
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 25-day break, won twice earlier this season and may benefit from freshness
runners_data.comment: Inadequate trip and long absent so may need this comeback run
runners_data.spotlight: Won over 1m at Bellewstown last August, adding to an early-season success over 7f at Gowran; lost ground at the start when reappearing at Navan, compromising his chance over a 6f trip that was probably inadequate in any case.

runners_data.name: Tynamite
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran winless on turf in 34 attempts, hard to recommend despite experience
runners_data.comment: Veteran, 0-33 on turf, never involved on seasonal return at Killarney, others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran is a six-time AW winner but 0-34 on turf; no success since December 2023; down the field in two starts this season.

runners_data.name: Queen Of Newark
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with late fade tendency, career-best effort last time suggests improvement but limitations exposed
runners_data.comment: Third in Roscommon maiden claimer 11 days ago; needs to pull out more back in a handicap
runners_data.spotlight: Weak form last season; never involved in 5f races in her first two handicap starts; career-best when third in Roscommon maiden claimer last month; limitations underlined when she was sent back into handicap company at Down Royal.

runners_data.name: Exceeding
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with no luck at Listowel last time, previous form improvement suggests capable on his day

runners_data.name: Concaire
runners_data.note: Hold-up type showing gradual improvement, handicap debut sixth suggests further progress feasible
runners_data.comment: Signs of improvement on handicap debut at Roscommon, trip and ground should suit
runners_data.spotlight: Signs of improvement on handicap debut when sixth of 14 at Roscommon a month ago; further progress is feasible.

runners_data.name: Gobi Star
runners_data.comment: Very little form of note on both AW and turf since December return; hard to fancy
runners_data.spotlight: Better record on AW when at his peak; very little merit in either AW or turf form in seven outings since last December, when he returned after a lengthy absence.

runners_data.name: Harry Longabaugh
runners_data.note: Sole front-runner gives him tactical advantage, modest form but uncontested lead creates winning opportunity
runners_data.comment: No improvement on handicap debut, dropped 3lb, can only be watched for now
runners_data.spotlight: Modest form in maidens; beat only one rival over 5f on handicap/seasonal debut at Naas; not much better in a 6f Fairyhouse contest.

runners_data.name: Pick A Window
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden making handicap debut, distance increase may help but little form substance to work with
runners_data.comment: No sign of worthwhile form in three outings last season, struggled again at Cork on return
runners_data.spotlight: No sign of worthwhile form in five maiden outings; makes handicap debut off a lowly mark; step up in trip may be some help.

runners_data.name: Sosperi
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 257-day absence with first-time blinkers, hard to assess current ability
runners_data.spotlight: Hard to take any encouragement from last season's form, blinkered for the first time; trainer had a good day at Navan on Sunday.

races.paceDynamic: Harry Longabaugh is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 14-runner handicap, meaning he can dictate terms without pressure through steady fractions on good to soft ground. With most runners holding up or racing in midfield, the early pace will be comfortable, allowing Harry Longabaugh to string out the field. The lack of pace pressure creates a scenario where the leader can kick clear in the straight before the hold-up horses can mount their challenges. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and the lone front-runner, as the soft pace will blunt the finishing kick of the many hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Dictates Terms
scenarios.trigger: If Harry Longabaugh gets uncontested fractions and maintains his kick
scenarios.body: The comfortable pace allows him to establish a winning margin before late closers can respond. Hold-up horses face an impossible task as the race becomes a procession.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If a prominent runner like Unfamiliar or Queen Of Newark can track the leader and outstay him
scenarios.body: They benefit from the steady pace while avoiding the traffic problems that will hamper the many hold-up horses. The tactical advantage of racing handy proves decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and one hold-up horse gets a perfect run through
scenarios.body: A horse like Exceeding or Dinamine could exploit late gaps if the leader stops quickly. The soft ground may help their stamina kick in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Harry Longabaugh fades badly and multiple hold-up horses converge together
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint finish where any of the many closers could prevail on a day when nothing goes to plan. Class could tell in a tight finish.

watchPoints.text: Harry Longabaugh must be watched closely in the betting as his front-running monopoly creates a significant tactical edge that the market may underestimate
Monitor how aggressively the prominent runners Unfamiliar and Queen Of Newark position themselves, as sitting too far back negates their style advantage
Watch for any market moves on Exceeding given his unlucky run last time and proven ability to find improvement
Check if any hold-up horses show early urgency to get closer, as breaking their natural pattern could indicate connections fear the pace scenario
Observe the behaviour of returning Sosperi with first-time blinkers after his long absence, as any market confidence would be telling

races.name: Racing Again On June 19th Handicap

runners_data.name: Autumn Twist
runners_data.note: Prominent racer likely to set moderate tempo, 26 days rest ideal but spring form below best
runners_data.comment: Form this spring below-best under both codes and others hold stronger claims
runners_data.spotlight: Ballinrobe maiden (1m2f) win last summer sandwiched by two hurdle sucesses, all on good ground; form this spring below-best under both codes however and unproven over this far.

runners_data.name: Loyal Touch
runners_data.note: Pure hold-up horse from strong yard, 68 days off concerns but previous course winner at this trip
runners_data.comment: Five-time British Flat winner but not at same level for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time Flat winner in Britain at up to 1m2f; not at same level for this yard, well beaten over hurdles last twice.

runners_data.name: Quiz Test
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with decent recent form, well-backed last time suggests confidence from connections
runners_data.comment: Almost three years since his only win, fair form last autumn, may improve from a Cork run
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win came at Cork in 2023; decent form last autumn, including a close third over 1m4f at Galway and second in a 19-runner contest at the Curragh; well-backed on latest of two runs this term when fourth at Gowran (Good Onya Mate second); 5lb claimer now rides but more exposed than that rival.

runners_data.name: Ellaat
runners_data.note: Patient ride essential, dual-purpose 10-year-old thrives over staying distances on this ground
runners_data.comment: No handicap hurdle win since 2022, poor start for this yard on Flat latest
runners_data.spotlight: Dual purpose 10yo whose Flat wins include 1m4f handicap here; comes here in good form after hurdle second at Ballinrobe last month off a fair mark.

runners_data.name: Our Lucky Lady
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning from hurdles success, 12 days turnaround and hooded first time scored at Down Royal
runners_data.comment: Proven a better hurdler since last running on the Flat; hood tried and may improve
runners_data.spotlight: Winning hurdler returned to Flat recently to justify strong market support when hooded first-time in 2m Down Royal handicap under today's rider, beating Sunday's Navan winner Jurality with some authority; hit with 12lb rise but could well play a role.

runners_data.name: Nod Of Approval
runners_data.note: Needs patient ride after tardy starts, best effort came over this trip when second at Cork
runners_data.comment: Half-brother to Puturhandstogether a potential improver now upped markedly in distance
runners_data.spotlight: Best run yet on latest when upped to 1m4f in Cork handicap in April, coming from good bit back after tardy start when second to an improver (won again next time); half-brother to Irish Cesarewitch winner Puturhandstogether could well improve again now upped further in distance.

runners_data.name: Bynx
runners_data.note: Hold-up hurdles winner winless on Flat but close over this trip at Thurles, 49 days off concern
runners_data.comment: Course winner over hurdles, 1-4 over fences, this more suitable than latest, chance
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdles winner (also chase winner) is 0-21 on the Flat but went close over this trip at Thurles last autumn off today's mark; can't rule out.

runners_data.name: Riyami
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor turf record, top weight makes task harder despite AW success
runners_data.comment: Sole hurdles win nearly two years ago; fitter for recent Flat run but unproven at 3m
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time AW winner at 2m; 0-12 on turf and recent form under both codes leaves him with a bit to find.

runners_data.name: Tatum
runners_data.note: Hold-up type resuming ideal trip after too sharp at Leopardstown, excellent 2023 campaign
runners_data.comment: Two wins at Leopardstown last year, 1m2f too sharp on latest, do better now; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Enjoyed an excellent campaign last season which included two wins at Leopardstown (1m4f/1m5f, good); 1m2f too sharp on return there last month, interesting now upped further in trip here with Keane aboard.

runners_data.name: Pass The Buck
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse stepping up in trip, tendency to fade in finish makes stamina questionable
runners_data.spotlight: Recent Ballinrobe maiden run was okay but will have to improve a fair bit for this step up in trip to make an impact on second handicap attempt (3lb wrong).

runners_data.name: Mr Rango
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist best on soft ground but hasn't won for over two years
runners_data.comment: Fair form this season but needs to find extra, ran in the 7.50 at Roscommon on Monday
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time winner at 1m2f on soft or heavy, latest over two years ago; fair form this season but good bit to find with a couple of these on recent Leopardstown run and remains unproven over this extended trip.

runners_data.name: Lauderdale King
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse improving with trip, third over extended 1m2f suggests stamina for this
runners_data.spotlight: Very lightly raced 4yo; nicely improved when upped in trip for handicap debut at Cork last month, coming home well into third over extended 1m2f (soft-to-heavy); interesting if he can continue improving at this longer trip.

runners_data.name: Miss Australie
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse just off maiden-breaking win over this trip, 5lb rise to overcome
runners_data.comment: Bit of encouragement last time at Ballinrobe when some late headway over 9.5f
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the 15th attempt in 1m4f Roscommon handicap last month (yielding-to-soft), coming from off the pace; 5lb rise so more needed but respected.

runners_data.name: Sioux Grit
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare returning after 753 days absence, tendency to fade and 9lb wrong makes task impossible
runners_data.comment: Second reserve; 0-18 and absent two years; 8lb wrong here
runners_data.spotlight: Mare returns from over two year's absence and hasn't troubled the judge in 18 previous attempts; 9lb wrong.

runners_data.name: Almenfee
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse failing to fire for current yard, German form doesn't translate
runners_data.comment: German winner yet to fire for this yard; wants good ground
runners_data.spotlight: German winner has failed to fire so far for this yard; declining mark but still best watched.

runners_data.name: Good Onya Mate
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse improving but tendency to fade in finish questions stamina credentials
runners_data.comment: Chance is not obvious, but the stable had a massive-priced double at Naas on Sunday
runners_data.spotlight: Nicely improved on second handicap attempt when enterprisingly-ridden over 1m6f at Gowran last month, green but rallying after being headed to finish a clear second (Quiz Test fourth); good chance he'll get this trip and likely more to offer.

races.paceDynamic: This race lacks genuine pace with only Autumn Twist showing confirmed front-running tendencies, but even he typically sits prominent rather than leading throughout. The opening half-mile will be steady with Autumn Twist, Tatum and potentially Quiz Test settling in the first four, creating a tactical affair with most of the 16-runner field bunched behind. The real race begins from the 3f pole when the hold-up horses start making their moves on the Good To Yielding ground. This sustainable pace strongly favours hold-up horses and patient rides, as they'll have the most energy reserves for the final 2f surge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Kick Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate as expected with Autumn Twist not pressured early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from 2f out with the strongest finishers prevailing, suiting horses that can quicken off the steady gallop. Hold-up specialists with proven stamina get first run on tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Autumn Twist goes too slow and the field gets backed up approaching halfway
scenarios.body: The race turns into a messy cavalry charge with traffic problems favouring those racing wide or getting early position. Prominent racers avoid the worst of the interference.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Quiz Test or another forward horse pressures Autumn Twist to go faster than ideal
scenarios.body: The genuine pace exposes stamina doubts and favours horses with proven staying power over this trip. Previous 2m+ winners and dual-purpose horses thrive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Autumn Twist gets an uncontested lead and the field fails to close the gap
scenarios.body: The pace-setter kicks clear approaching the final furlong and holds on, with only the fastest closers getting near. Sharp horses with turn of foot threaten late.

watchPoints.text: Autumn Twist could set too slow a pace early which would turn this into a messy sprint finish
Our Lucky Lady racing off just 12 days turnaround after hurdles win may have stamina reserves depleted
Quiz Test and Miss Australie both coming off recent wins and could be overbet in market
Several hold-up horses including Pass The Buck and Good Onya Mate have shown tendencies to fade in the finish
Track conditions described as Good To Yielding throughout the card should suit the patient hold-up horses
